newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australis sees red ink to 1998.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australis sees red ink to 1998.

text.p: Pay television operator Australis Media Ltd said on Tuesday it expected to make losses until at least the 1997/98 year (ending June 30).

"The company expects that it will have significant negative cash flow from operating activities and investing activities in each fiscal year through at least fiscal 1998," Australis said in a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange.

Australis said the continuance and magnitude of such negative cash flow would be significantly impacted by several factors including subscription prices, subscriber growth and revenues from its supply agreement with fellow pay TV operator, the News Corp and Telstra Corp-owned Foxtel.

On September 13, Australis reported a 1995/96 net loss of A$251.7 million. The company is currently in the throes of a recapitalisation plan, which it said most current bondholders had approved, subject to conditions.
The recapitalisation consists of raising US$150 million in senior debt and another US$100 million in new equity, with both planned for completion by October 31.

Australis shareholders include Kerry Packer's Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd, the Australian Mutual Provident Society, Guiness Peat Group Plc, United International Holdings Inc, and Lenfest, an affiliate of cable group Telecommunications Inc.
Australis shares closed one cent lower at 19 cents on turnover of 1.53 million shares.
